Penal Code, 1860 – ss. 376, 452 and 506 – Acquittal under – Allegation that appellant committed offence against the prosecutrix (PW-6) u/s. 376 at her residence – The appellant-accused was charged and convicted u/ss. 376, 452 and 506 by the Trial Court and the same was On appeal, held: There was delay in filing complaint – There was no attempt to recover the knife from the appellant as it is a specific case of the prosecution that he committed the offence by threatening to harm the prosecutrix – There was no reason as to non-examination of the sole
